name: Factorized Ores
summary: Tired of looking for ores in mines? well this mod adds a block that you can factorize to generate infinite minerals
description: # Renewable Resources - RR ![Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6167e1a208769714b8ad7dd9c75a3719d91c3f9.png) This mod introduces a block called Infinity Stone that regenerates after being harvested or exploded, and will drop minerals and cobblestone. ![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7027b9b7f20d91d95043f020157776608bc6a4f.png) - The block can only be mined with a pickaxe. - When mined, the block drops a single item selected by weighted probabilities: - 80% Cobblestone - 20% Minerals: coal, iron ingot, gold ingot, redstone, lapis, or diamond - Fortune enchantment affects only mineral drops, not cobblestone. - Experience (XP) is granted for certain drops: coal, redstone, lapis, and diamond, typically 2–4 XP. - If a hopper is located within 3 blocks below the block, XP can be bottled into XP bottles in that hopper. - Without a suitable hopper, XP spawns as XP orbs. - The block can be permanently obtained only by right-clicking with an empty hand (both hands must be empty).
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio

gallery.title: When block is mined above a hopper
gallery.description: The minerals will auto go into the hopper, without spitting out so its easier and more efficient
